note: Every figure is computed using only races run STRICTLY BEFORE the race it describes — the `as_of` date on each horse. Groups with fewer than two runs are omitted rather than shown as a rate, because a 100% strike rate over one run is noise wearing the clothes of a finding. Our archive runs to 2026-10-06: a horse that ran after that date has those runs missing here, so read `career` as what we hold, not as a complete record.

breeding_coverage.note: Sire totals count the progeny we hold. Breeding is complete for races up to 2026-07-22. After that date our live source carries it for about half of runners; we recover most of the rest from the same horse's other races, but not all. Recent races are therefore under-counted in sire totals.
